The homes are presented with strata-style language (garage, reserved parking, slips) in their listing texts.
Inland farm and acreage parcels

The remaining listings we checked are inland acreage/farm listings on 34b Avenue and 64 Street, per their listing texts — working farms and bare agricultural land under the Agriculture (A) designation and A1 zoning where the zone applies, farm parcels with equestrian facilities within the A1 stall limit, and operations using migrant farm worker housing under the A1 criteria. Farm parcels carry at most the A1 dwelling set in — none of it is strata condo stock.
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Plan and farm zoning: the inland farm ground is planned under the Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) — a single consolidated plan — which designates farm land "Agriculture (A)" (s. 1.5.1). The A1 Agriculture zone is the zone intended for farming, breeding pets, kennels and related uses.

Nearby areas: Ladner village and its sub-areas (Hawthorne, Holly, Delta Manor, Neilsen Grove) to the east, East Delta beyond them, Westham Island to the west, and Tsawwassen to the south. Ladner's known condo stock sits in those village sub-areas — none of it is in Ladner Rural.

Flood and drainage geography: the City of Delta operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure (dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection), 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure; in the agricultural area the ditches and pump stations function in drainage mode in winter and in irrigation mode in summer, when ditch water is used to irrigate crops, with control gate structures regulating water levels.

Transit and health care: TransLink route 601 runs via Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), and Ladner Exchange sits beside Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, Delta — Fraser Health's community hospital for Delta with 24/7 emergency care.

ALR residences cannot be stratified. The Agricultural Land Commission's Information Bulletin 09 (issued October 18, 2022), s. 6, treats strata plans as plans that cause subdivision; under the Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1) a person must not subdivide agricultural land unless permitted by the Commission after an application or permitted under the ALR General Regulation, and the Strata Property Act route (s. 239) does not get around that bar. Practical consequence: farm ground in Ladner Rural produces farm houses and farm dwelling units, never a strata condo building — which is why is zero.

A1 dwelling rules (the housing this area actually allows): farming is a principal use in the A1 zone, and accessory uses include a farm house accessory to farming, one secondary suite accessory to a farm house, an accessory farm dwelling unit, migrant farm worker housing, and equestrian facilities to a maximum of 40 permanent stalls accessory to farming. One farm house per lot is permitted, maximum total floor area 500 m², on a farm home plate of at most 3,600 m² (5,000 m² where an additional farm house is also on the plate); one accessory farm dwelling unit per lot — maximum 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less, 186 m² on lots over 40 ha — located on the same farm home plate, with ALC approval required for more than one; an additional farm house (180 m² maximum on lots under 8 ha, 233 m² on lots of 8 ha or more) requires a Professional Agrologist's report supporting its necessity and written ALC approval.

Form B (for completeness — it has nothing to attach to here): Strata Property Act s. 59 requires a strata corporation to provide a Form B Information Certificate within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. In Ladner Rural there is no known strata apartment building for a buyer to request one from; if a float-home interest is presented as strata, the Form B and the strata plan are exactly the documents that would prove it — request them before treating any such claim as fact.

Rental and age bylaws (strata rules): rental-restriction bylaws are void since November 24, 2022, and only a 55+ age bylaw is lawful (Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2 and Regulation 7.01, with exemptions for legacy residents, live-in caregivers and, from May 1, 2023, younger spouses/partners and defined children) — both are strata-bylaw rules and neither has a building to apply to in Ladner Rural.
The guide's scope is wider than the area page's — on paper only. A buyer comparing the two pages should know the guide's extra geography has no known content behind it yet.

The zero here is structural, not a market dip. ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; ALCA s. 21(1); SPA s. 239), so no condo building can appear on this area through any market cycle — a "Ladner Rural condo coming soon" claim should be treated as an error until a non-ALR parcel and a registered strata plan are produced.
The same ditch is drainage in winter and irrigation in summer. In Delta's agricultural area the City's ditches and pump stations switch modes seasonally under control gates.
There are no Ladner Rural statistics to quote — and no substitute is allowed. SnapStats does not cover South Delta and publishes no farm, acreage or float-home category.

What trades here

items.t: Fee-simple farm parcels are the inland land form: From the official material: working farms and bare agricultural land under Agriculture (A) / A1, farm parcels with equestrian facilities within the A1 stall limit (a maximum of 40 permanent stalls accessory to farming), and operations using migrant farm worker housing under the A1 criteria.

The A1 frame, as the zone states it: farming is a principal use; accessory uses include a farm house accessory to farming, one secondary suite accessory to a farm house, an accessory farm dwelling unit, migrant farm worker housing, and equestrian facilities to a maximum of 40 permanent stalls accessory to farming. One farm house per lot is permitted, maximum total floor area 500 m²; the farm home plate maximum is 3,600 m² for a farm house with or without an accessory farm dwelling unit (5,000 m² where an additional farm house is also on the plate).
Lot character, only: no typical lot size is stated for the sub-area.

ALR vs non-ALR split: no area-wide split is published and none is stated. The site's own copy says much of the belt is in the Agricultural Land Reserve — page copy, not a measured split. A specific parcel's ALR status is checked on the Agricultural Land Commission maps by PID or civic address; the ALC states its online tools are for general reference only, with official confirmation from its Mapping and GIS team.
Bare-land strata: none — and barred on ALR ground: On ALR ground the form is barred in any case: residences in the ALR cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)).

Float homes — documented as a tenure question, never as lot stock: The West River Road cards are float homes in a marina setting per their listing texts, with boat slips described as part of, or rented through, the complex, and strata-style language (garage, reserved parking, slips) in those texts.

Water, drainage and flood are part of the land here: the City operates and maintains 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure; in the agricultural area the ditches and pump stations function in drainage mode in winter and in irrigation mode in summer, when water in the ditches is used to irrigate crops, with control gate structures regulating water levels for agricultural use. The City also operates over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure between the Fraser River, Boundary Bay and Georgia Strait.

items.t: The acreage figures in those texts are listing text, cited here as feed composition only, not as verified parcel facts.

The site's own copy describes Ladner Rural as the farmland around Ladner — hobby farms, bigger working farms and country homes on acreage, much of it in the Agricultural Land Reserve, a short drive from Ladner Village — cited as page identity only.

Getting around: TransLink route 601 runs via Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station, and Ladner Exchange sits beside Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd (Fraser Health community hospital, 24/7 emergency care).

SD37 publishes catchment boundary maps for the Ladner Area (elementary and secondary, updated October 2017) and directs families to the Baragar School Locator or their local school — a map/document-based statement, not a locator run.
SnapStats does not cover South Delta / Ladner (its Delta coverage is North Delta only, never used here), and it publishes no farm, acreage or float-home category.

ALR block — the governing frame for most of this area: residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within the principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Delta's A1 text states the same structure in zone terms: one accessory farm dwelling unit per lot (90 m² maximum on lots of 40 ha or less, 186 m² on lots over 40 ha) on the same farm home plate as the farm house, ALC approval required for more than one; an additional farm house (180 m² maximum on lots under 8 ha, 233 m² on lots of 8 ha or more) requires a Professional Agrologist's report supporting its necessity and written ALC approval. Migrant farm worker housing is permitted only where, among other criteria, the lot is in the ALR with farming as a permitted use, the lot is classified as a farm under the Assessment Act, written ALC approval has been obtained, the farm employing the workers is at least 8 ha and the lot is at least 4 ha.

Migrant worker housing has a hard size gate. A1 permits it only where the employing farm is at least 8 ha and the lot at least 4 ha, the lot is in the ALR and farm-classified, and written ALC approval is in hand — and new buildings for it must be manufactured homes on a temporary foundation or footings. A parcel under those thresholds cannot add it by right.
The 8 ha rule is a subdivision floor, not a parcel description.

faq.a: The sub-area's housing is farm houses and farm dwelling units on ALR/A1 ground (which cannot be stratified) plus float homes on West River Road, which are moorage product, not strata apartment condos. Ladner's known condo buildings are all in the village sub-areas.
faq.q: Are there any condos in Ladner Rural?

faq.a: Because stratification is a subdivision, and ALR land cannot be subdivided without Agricultural Land Commission permission: ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6 treats strata plans as plans that cause subdivision, ALCA s. 21(1) bars subdividing agricultural land unless permitted by the Commission or the ALR General Regulation, and the Strata Property Act s. 239 route does not get around that bar.
faq.q: Why can't a farm property here be turned into condos?

faq.a: The listing texts present the West River Road homes with strata-style language and boat slips. Diligence the tenure first: establish what is actually owned (the float, the slip, any lease or strata interest), what the moorage costs and rules are, and how financing and insurance treat a float home, before pricing it like a condo.
